operation: Center the exact cubic residual compiler on acquired nonlinear prestress. Affine prestress coordinates remove this artificial cancellation without changing the physical trial subspace.

discriminant: Compare unchanged new-support cases 8/16/24/32mm with matched acquired-support cases 1/9/17/25mm. At each matched support also supply kappa multipliers .95 and1.05 as genuinely changed history ports. Separate arithmetic floor, spatial topology approximation and history transfer.
strong_control: Same-information affine polynomial residual Gram / reduced-basis control; TIE if identical
no_claim: Basis has 17 coordinates and cannot be assumed to represent unseen cut-tip cusps; frozen-history residual certificate does not certify nonlinear damage branch evolution
